method: coordinate search, walk-forward predict years 2020-2024 (train <= Y-1), objective = mean trials-weighted MAE, min_trials=100, ages = Chadwick register (June 30); age term constrained to a peak in 25-31 with slopes of opposite signs; components whose fit does not beat stock on an inner validation (fit 2020-2022, score 2023-2024) keep stock's constants

league_rate.chosen_on: inner validation inside the tuning window: fit 2020-2022 with the league option pinned, score 2023-2024; the holdout is never consulted
